c001-s1.meaning: A rude, unkind or selfish person.
c001-s1.example: Don't be a jerk and apologize to her.

c002-s1.meaning: Things you care about so strongly that you give them your time.
c002-s1.example: Her two passions are painting and long-distance running.

c004-s1.meaning: Felt suddenly frightened, upset or very uneasy about something.
c004-s1.example: She freaked out when she saw the huge spider.

c007-s1.meaning: Frightening dreams that make you wake up scared.
c007-s1.example: The scary film gave him nightmares for a week.

c008-s1.meaning: Sharp curved nails on an animal's foot, or a machine part shaped like them.
c008-s1.example: The cat sank its claws into the sofa.

c010-s1.meaning: Made two devices or sets of data match and work together.
c010-s1.example: My phone synced with my laptop overnight.

tr.hi: सिंक किया गया, मिलान किया गया

c016-s1.meaning: Informal: someone very talented and admired, like a famous musician.
c016-s1.example: The new chef is a real rockstar in this city.

c020-s1.meaning: Everything is ready and working, so the activity can begin.
c020-s1.example: The engineers checked everything and said, all systems go.

tr.hi: सब कुछ तैयार है, शुरू करो

c030-s1.meaning: Gentle and loving, careful not to hurt someone.
c030-s1.example: He gave the sleeping child a tender kiss.

c042-s1.meaning: Go faster or do something more quickly.
c042-s1.example: We need to speed up or we'll miss the train.

c047-s1.meaning: To damage something so badly that it no longer exists.
c047-s1.example: The storm could destroy the whole village.

c050-s1.meaning: Stop a plan or mission before it is finished.
c050-s1.example: The pilot had to abort the landing.

tr.hi: रद्द करो, बीच में रोक दो

c055-s1.meaning: Made me feel deep sadness, especially by ending a relationship.
c055-s1.example: It broke her heart when her best friend moved away.

c059-s1.meaning: To press or hit something so hard it is destroyed, or defeat someone completely.
c059-s1.example: The team hopes to crush its rivals this weekend.

c062-s1.meaning: Something said or done on the spot, without planning or a script.
c062-s1.example: The actor's funny ad-lib made the whole crew laugh.

tr.hi: बिना तैयारी के बोली गई बात

c064-s1.meaning: One particular occasion; here, on this occasion, unlike before.
c064-s1.example: I failed the test last year, but this time I passed.

c066-s1.meaning: The amount of minutes or hours left before something must end.
c066-s1.example: Hurry up, there is very little time before the show starts.

c075-s1.meaning: Something useful you should understand from an experience, often a mistake.
c075-s1.example: After the failed project, there was a lesson to be learned.

c076-s1.meaning: The result was not as bad as it might have been.
c076-s1.example: We lost, but honestly it could have gone worse.

tr.hi: इससे बुरा भी हो सकता था
